title: SDK models repo workspace client must resolve host and token before falling back to default auth
answers: serverless model load fails with default auth cannot configure default credentials
SEG or internet-restricted compute cannot download UC model
Databricks SDK WorkspaceClient fails on Spark executors
body:
Symptom: On serverless or SEG compute, loading or registering a UC model through the SDK path fails with a 'default auth: cannot configure default credentials' error.
Root cause: mlflow/store/artifact/databricks_sdk_models_artifact_repo.py:_get_databricks_workspace_client builds the client; a bare WorkspaceClient() has no credentials on Spark executors there.
Fix pattern: Resolve host and token first through mlflow/utils/databricks_utils.py:get_databricks_host_creds(registry_uri), build WorkspaceClient(host=..., token=...) when both are present, and fall back to WorkspaceClient() only otherwise. Log resolution failures at debug and continue.
Constraints: Callers must pass registry_uri (load) or store_uri (register) through to the repo constructor. Classic compute still works through the default-auth fallback.
applies: Client construction inside DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository; any new SDK-backed artifact repo that runs on executors.
says: Loading catalog models on serverless compute fails with missing default credential errors.
Cannot download registered models when running on secure internet-restricted clusters.
Model registry operations fail on distributed worker nodes because credentials are not found.
Allow serverless jobs to access registered models using the configured workspace credentials.
search: In DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository, the Databricks SDK client must explicitly resolve host and token before falling back to default authentication. mlflow/store/artifact/databricks_sdk_models_artifact_repo.py:_get_databricks_workspace_client must resolve credentials via mlflow/utils/databricks_utils.py:get_databricks_host_creds using registry_uri for loading or store_uri for registering, instantiating WorkspaceClient(host=..., token=...) when available. Bare WorkspaceClient() is retained strictly as a fallback for classic compute, while credential resolution failures log at debug level.
